svg.title: CGAT: reference-guided integration and targeted repair
svg.desc: Four related panels: complementary assembly integration, chromosome organization, assembly-derived GRT repair and iterative read-driven repair. Schematic coordinates, not measured base pairs. Detailed alignment parameters remain in the companion DEGAP figure.

g.inkscape:label: a Inputs, complementary assemblies, residual gap/end and final path; no redundant seed/read zooms.
b Assignment, A2/A1 reordering and A2 orientation; A3 unplaced.
c Complete three-case GRT schematic, including the correction inset.

svg.title: GPM/GRT: assembly-derived repair
svg.desc: Three assembly-derived repair contexts retained from the right-hand GRT mechanism figure: anchor-based filling, flanking-extension filling, and correction with filling. One shared upper target path and one shared lower repaired example path span all three contexts. L and R are anchoring regions; S is the donor insert. The third context retains its correction inset and return arrow. Telomere markers occur only at the four original main-path endpoints, plus the legend. This schematic is not a universal completion claim or measured base-pair data.

g.inkscape:label: 04 One shared before path and one shared result path
05 Local target, donor and extracted pieces
06 Correction inset retained from the reference
08 Live text and compact original legend
d Shared extension cycle, GapFiller rounds and alternative TelSeeker joins.
